n: The new ZSCPRG01 output (with BUn and SC Type) replaces ZSCSRV1: unit and type of works come from the certificates
The PO title is the PO's type of works · ZSCSRV1 is optional – dropped with the files, it is still used
Coding follows your cost report: the PKG list shows its PKGs with their names (S03 · CONCRETE (STR-03)), tagged budget
The cost element list of a budget PKG starts with its budget resources (of the row's MNL) with their BAC – pick one so the cost lands on its budget
Budget: a search box on every page – it looks in every column
Cost Analysis opens on All PKGs; an MNL column (MAT / SUB / LAB / EQU) on Cost Analysis and the PKG pages
Budget: a filter under every column – text, or >1000 / <0 for numbers; sums follow
All PKGs grouped as in your report (Civil · Arch · MEP) with dashed borders and a sum per group
New tab Cost Analysis: each BOQ item with its resources – usage, waste, rates by type, budget rate, BAC, EV
New section Budget: read your cost report (Direct plan + Cost Analysis, .xlsb or .xlsx) – budget per PKG and resource
PKG pages like your S-sheets: budget, earned value, actuals from your coding, add / omission, provision, ETC (qty × rate), EAC, VAC, actual losses
Progress: done qty per BOQ item and building type; All PKGs summary; Excel: a Budget summary tab and a tab per PKG
Include VAT before date: the date box sits on its own line under the VAT list – no longer hidden at the edge of the side navigation

The earlier Material and Subcontractor reports: codes come from their Data tab – each item takes the code that carries most of its amount, a line coded differently keeps its own; the Coding sheet only where the Data tab has nothing
A row you code under a filter stays in the list (marked yellow) until you change the filter – or press Refresh
Enter and Ctrl+D always move on to the next row
Import codes… takes several files at once (e.g. the Material report and the Subcontractor report)
Create the register with several last reports – e.g. the Material report and the Subcontractor report together; the codes of all of them come in
The earlier Material report: its Data tab codes each issue line (Material doc.) – a line coded other than its material keeps its own code
A report of another project asks before its codes are read
Codes › PKG list shows the whole list – no filter buttons; a PKG without a name says "No name yet" on its row
You choose when to update: a new version shows in the top bar with What's new, Update and Later – nothing changes until you press Update
Your data file is never touched by an update
Monthly job: step 4 opens what is still open; step 5 has Export the monthly report
